description: City of Toronto publishes building information for the rental apartment buildings registered under the Apartment Building Standard bylaw (Chapter 354), which identifies rental apartment buildings of three or more storeys and ten or more units, as part of the RentSafeTO multi-residential inspection programme; a companion portal dataset (apartment-building-evaluation) holds the evaluation scores. Coverage: the City of Toronto; the record was last modified on 2026-07-05. Format and access: CSV, XML, JSON, downloadable without registration from the City of Toronto Open Data portal; the portal also serves the metadata through a public API. Licence (read on the portal page on 2026-09-29): Open Government Licence - Toronto (open-government-licence-toronto); cost: free. Caveats: only registered rental buildings of three or more storeys with ten or more units are covered, and the file was not opened, so the full field list and any energy or structure attributes are unconfirmed. Simulation uses: multi-residential building stock characterisation for retrofit, heat-vulnerability and evacuation studies, and joined to building outlines for exposure. Related catalogue records: Urban Form Toronto: built environment and walkability measures on a 100 m hexagon grid (data-toronto-urban-form-hex-measures); City of Toronto watermain breaks 1990 to 2016 (data-toronto-watermain-breaks); OpenStreetMap (data-openstreetmap).
